name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Crankbait goes with exactly one of Mabel, Wade, or Grayreach.
Either Dale goes with Swimbait or Crankbait goes with Dale.
Either Cody goes with Spinnerbait, or Mabel goes with Spoon — but not both.
Foxglen, Grayreach, and Willowmere go with Cody, Spoon, and Swimbait, in some order.
Birchpool, Grayreach, and Willowmere go with Spinnerbait, Swimbait, and Wobbler, in some order.
Either Wobbler goes with Foxglen or Wobbler goes with Willowmere.

hints.text: Suppose Cody went with Birchpool — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Cody goes with Birchpool.
Cody goes with Birchpool, so it can't also go with Foxglen.
Cody goes with Birchpool, so it can't also go with Grayreach.
Cody goes with Birchpool, so it can't also go with Willowmere.
…but now the clue “Foxglen, Grayreach, and Willowmere go with Cody, Spoon, and Swimbait, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Cody does not go with Birchpool.
